items.title: Polish DEV Rift controls, summon quantity footer and Party labels
items.quote: After reviewing real iPhone screenshots of Adventure (Party open and folded), Rift Upgrades (top and scrolled), and Auto Summon (top and scrolled), Joshua approved the proposed **small, targeted visual polish** rather than moving to Haven or Realm 2: "Yes."

asks.text: This is unchanged from my last report. Part D (the shard cost under the summon portal, clipped at 320 and 390 wide) and part E (the Party level badge sticking out about 2px at 320 wide) still belong to #103/#120 and #106. I left them alone. My suggestions are in my earlier comment above.

On phones narrower than 360, the Auto quantity now reads "×10" instead of "×10 Summons". At 360 and wider, the full word fits with room to spare, so it stays there. I think this is the right cut-off: at 340 the full label would only just fit, with about 4px to spare.

items.title: Preview approved Common companions in existing detail screen
items.quote: "Ok" [to preparing a test version of companion-detail screens using already approved sprites and habitat backgrounds].  "Yeah I like all the ones so far that are there."

asks.text: The preview page, the five 768px Common pictures and now five background scenes (about 14 MB) are in the game folder, so they would go live if this is merged. My suggestion: before merging, move them to reviews/ like #83 did, or keep only what Joshua picks.

Removing size and weight changes companion-profile.js, which is used by the Team page, the Omnidex, the summon reveal and the tutorial. Neither #108 nor #116 changes that file, so they still combine on the test site. My suggestion: merge this after #108.
The lunge now repeats every 4 seconds, the same timing as the tutorial, and a tap plays it at once. I think it suits the page. If it feels busy while you read stats, 6 seconds would be calmer.

Every companion except the starters now gets a soft glow, three sparkles and a strike flash in its category's colours, placed a bit differently each time. I kept it to three sparkles, the same as the starters, so the page stays calm. A Rare or higher companion could get one or two extra sparkles later if you want them to feel more special.

Mortals, Spirits and Aberrations had no strike flash in the tutorial, so I gave them one in the same style: a gold diamond for Mortals, a pale star for Spirits and a jagged violet shard for Aberrations.
Size and weight are removed everywhere. The tutorial's "A NEW BOND" screen now shows the starter's short description in that spot instead of leaving it empty.

I picked one scene for each new Common: Reedwatch Tinker with Wetland Reeds, Millward Bellkeeper with Ancient Gate, Dewfern with Fungal Hollow, Coppice Cricket with Thorn Bramble and Unstitch with Rift Fracture. They're only on the preview page. Tell me which pairs you like and I'll make them those companions' backgrounds in the game.

items.title: Set 0.2-second Auto Summon and replace Tome opening with Rift spin-up
items.quote: during auto summons it goes back to .5 seconds per companion. Also the tome animation needs to be removed when opening one at a time. I think it should be replaced with the portal gif spinning up faster than having the screen pop up.

asks.text: A tap on the Rift now spins it up for 0.3 seconds before the result opens. I think that's a good length: it feels quick, but you still see it. In 0.3 seconds the swirl turns one and a half times, so it ends quite fast. If it looks like a flicker on your phone, I'd make it one full turn instead.

I kept the shorter effect for repeats that the game already had: repeat Commons and Uncommons play at a bit under half the length, and new or Rare-and-up companions get the full effect. That's what you asked for, so I didn't make it any shorter.

items.quote: put all realm two companions ... add them now to the loot pool ... all currently created companions should be loaded and omnidex and all that updated to show all rarities and stuff available now

asks.text: Summoning the new companions waits for #78's Portal. Once #78 merges, I'll add their chances there, the way you approved: each rarity keeps its total, ordinary companions share it evenly, Parallax Shard gets Crooked Eye's rate, Riftmourn gets Forgotten Watcher's 0.1%, and Epic's 1% comes from Common. Please comment "@claude add the summon chances" here after #78 merges.

Two of Realm 1's achievements count every discovery, not just Realm 1's: "Discover every Realm 1 species" (30) and "Many voices" (10). Once Realm 2 companions can be summoned, Realm 2 finds would count toward them too. I suggest making both count Realm 1 only, in the same change that adds the summon chances.
